versions.changelog:
Initial release of Pricing Strategy Analyzer.

- Analyzes and optimizes pricing using value-based, cost-plus, competitive, and tiered models
- Includes pricing power analysis, Van Westendorp willingness-to-pay calculator, and tiered (Good/Better/Best) modeling
- Identifies common pricing mistakes and generates competitor pricing matrices
- Provides actionable recommendations with estimated revenue impact
- Supports price elasticity testing and tracks key metrics such as ACV, discounting, and expansion revenue
